stem.text: An investigation was carried out on the effect of temperature on an enzyme-catalysed reaction.
The enzyme and its substrate were initially placed into separate test-tubes and raised to the temperature required. They were then mixed and placed into four tubes **A**, **B**, **C** and **D**.
These tubes were incubated for the time and at the temperature stated. The mass of the product formed was then measured.
In which tube was the rate of reaction highest?
